paragraphs: PlanStreet sells cloud-based case management software that organizations use to run programs, cases, and referrals. The software covers client registration, assessment, service delivery, and changes to case plans. Intake forms can be picked from a supplied database or designed by the organization, with data validation and conditionality.

Two groups are named on the homepage: nonprofits, and government and public sector organizations. For the public sector the page frames the work as public welfare programs, with the software described as secure and compliant. A case studies page profiles housing, residential treatment, reentry, veterans, and child services organizations.

Grant management, collaboration, and task management are offered alongside custom reports and configurable user interfaces. The stated aim of the analytics and reporting tools is to monitor program impact across the case management cycle. The site says the system integrates with the tools and technology stack an organization already uses.

quote.text: PlanStreet helps organize programs and develops reporting tools in a single software solution.
